```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(survivalROC)
```

## Overview

Validates two Lasso-Cox signatures from CPTAC-PDA on the independent Tong et al. (2022) cohort (226 PDAC tumors).

**Signatures:**
1. Tong ≥80% — proteins detected in ≥80% of Tong tumors
2. Both Cohorts ≥80% — proteins detected in ≥80% of both Tong & APGI

---

## 1. Load Survival Data

```{r load_survival}
surv_raw <- read_excel(here("Data", "Tong-PDA", "13045_2022_1384_MOESM23_ESM.xlsx"), sheet = "Table S1B")
surv <- data.frame(
  SampleID = as.character(surv_raw[[1]]),
  OS_days = as.numeric(as.character(surv_raw[["Overall Survival (Months)"]])),
  OS_event = as.numeric(as.character(surv_raw[["Status of OS ( 1: death; 0: survival or loss to follow up )"]]))
)
cat("Survival data:", nrow(surv), "samples\n")
```

---

## 2. Validation Function

```{r validation_function}
validate_tong <- function(sig_label) {
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Validating:", sig_label, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  # Load prepared Tong data
  infile <- paste0("tong_validation_", sig_label, ".csv")
  val <- read.csv(here("Data", "Tong-PDA", infile))
  cat("Validation data:", nrow(val), "samples\n")
  
  # Merge with survival
  val$SampleID_clean <- gsub("T$", "", val$SampleID)
  merged <- merge(val, surv, by.x = "SampleID_clean", by.y = "SampleID")
  merged <- merged[!duplicated(merged$SampleID_clean), ]
  cat("Merged samples:", nrow(merged), "\n")
  
  # Median split
  median_risk <- median(merged$RiskScore)
  merged$RiskGroup <- ifelse(merged$RiskScore > median_risk, "High Risk", "Low Risk")
  cat("Median risk score:", round(median_risk, 4), "\n")
  cat("High Risk:", sum(merged$RiskGroup == "High Risk"), "\n")
  cat("Low Risk:", sum(merged$RiskGroup == "Low Risk"), "\n")
  
  # Convert OS from months to days
  merged$OS_time <- merged$OS_days * 30.4375
  
  # --- KM ---
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ RiskGroup, data = merged)
  
  # --- Log-rank ---
  lr <- survdiff(Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ RiskGroup, data = merged)
  logrank_p <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = 1)
  
  # --- Median survival ---
  km_summary <- surv_median(km_fit)
  
  # --- Cox (categorical) ---
  cox_cat <- coxph(Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ RiskGroup, data = merged)
  cox_cat_sum <- summary(cox_cat)
  
  # --- Cox (continuous) ---
  cox_cont <- coxph(Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ RiskScore, data = merged)
  cox_cont_sum <- summary(cox_cont)
  
  hr_cont <- exp(coef(cox_cont))
  hr_cont_ci <- exp(confint(cox_cont))
  hr_cont_p <- cox_cont_sum$coefficients[5]
  
  cat(sprintf("HR per unit RiskScore: %.2f (%.2f-%.2f), p = %.1e\n", 
              hr_cont, hr_cont_ci[1], hr_cont_ci[2], hr_cont_p))
  
  # --- C-index ---
  c_index <- concordance(Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ RiskScore, data = merged)$concordance
  c_index <- ifelse(c_index < 0.5, 1 - c_index, c_index)
  cat("C-index:", round(c_index, 3), "\n")
  
  # --- Time-Dependent AUC ---
  res_1yr <- survivalROC(Stime = merged$OS_days, status = merged$OS_event,
                          marker = merged$RiskScore, predict.time = 12, method = "KM")
  res_2yr <- survivalROC(Stime = merged$OS_days, status = merged$OS_event,
                          marker = merged$RiskScore, predict.time = 24, method = "KM")
  cat("1-Year AUC:", round(res_1yr$AUC, 3), "\n")
  cat("2-Year AUC:", round(res_2yr$AUC, 3), "\n")
  
  # Number of proteins used in this signature
  n_prot <- sum(!names(val) %in% c("RiskScore", "SampleID", "SampleID_clean"))
  
  results <- data.frame(
    Signature = sig_label,
    N_Samples = nrow(merged),
    N_Proteins = n_prot,
    HR = round(hr_cont, 3),
    HR_Lower = round(hr_cont_ci[1], 3),
    HR_Upper = round(hr_cont_ci[2], 3),
    HR_pval = format(hr_cont_p, digits = 4),
    C_Index = round(c_index, 3),
    LogRank_pval = format(logrank_p, digits = 4),
    AUC_1yr = round(res_1yr$AUC, 3),
    AUC_2yr = round(res_2yr$AUC, 3),
    MedianSurv_High = round(km_summary$median[1], 1),
    MedianSurv_Low = round(km_summary$median[2], 1)
  )
  
  return(list(
    label = sig_label,
    results = results,
    merged = merged,
    km_fit = km_fit,
    cox_cont = cox_cont,
    c_index = c_index,
    logrank_p = logrank_p,
    auc_1yr = res_1yr$AUC,
    auc_2yr = res_2yr$AUC
  ))
}
```

---

## 3. Run Validation

```{r run_validation}
sig_labels <- c("Tong_ge80pct", "Both_ge80pct")
val_results <- list()
for (sig in sig_labels) {
  r <- validate_tong(sig)
  if (!is.null(r)) val_results[[length(val_results) + 1]] <- r
}
```

---

## 4. Summary Table

```{r summary_table}
metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(val_results, function(r) r$results))
knitr::kable(metrics_df, caption = "Tong Validation Results", digits = 3)
```

---

## 5. Kaplan-Meier Curves

```{r km_curves, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
for (res in val_results) {
  p <- ggsurvplot(res$km_fit, data = res$merged, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE,
                  conf.int = TRUE,
                  title = paste("Tong Validation:", res$label),
                  xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "Overall Survival",
                  palette = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"),
                  legend.title = "Risk Group",
                  legend.labs = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))
  print(p)
}
```

---

## 6. Time-Dependent ROC Curves

```{r roc_curves, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
for (res in val_results) {
  merged <- res$merged
  res_1yr <- survivalROC(Stime = merged$OS_days, status = merged$OS_event,
                          marker = merged$RiskScore, predict.time = 12, method = "KM")
  res_2yr <- survivalROC(Stime = merged$OS_days, status = merged$OS_event,
                          marker = merged$RiskScore, predict.time = 24, method = "KM")
  
  plot(res_1yr$FP, res_1yr$TP, type = "l", col = "#E41A1C", lwd = 3,
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
       xlab = "1 - Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity",
       main = paste("Tong:", res$label))
  lines(res_2yr$FP, res_2yr$TP, col = "#377EB8", lwd = 3)
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "darkgrey")
  legend("bottomright",
         c(paste0("1-Year (AUC = ", round(res_1yr$AUC, 2), ")"),
           paste0("2-Year (AUC = ", round(res_2yr$AUC, 2), ")")),
         col = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"), lty = 1, lwd = 3)
}
```

---

## 7. Export Results

```{r export, include=FALSE}
write.csv(metrics_df, here("Results", "Tong_Validation_MetricsSummary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Exported to Results/Tong_Validation_MetricsSummary.csv\n")
```
